en.headline: 22 own commits plus 26 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **22 own commits** were recorded, plus 26 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 20 own commits added MiMo and Hunyuan 4 evaluation artifacts, including single-clock loop animations, a static SVG prompt page, and archived pelican-bike results with prompt text. The same repository also gained knowledge notes on the Console object model, BSK daemon startup and extension troubleshooting, new-window behavior, and BrowserSkill shortcuts. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 2 own commits upgraded the gallery into a Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, and added 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers plus a browsable gallery page. `antfu` replied to two `vercel-labs/skills` listing issues, explaining that `skills.sh` indexes skills automatically after installation with telemetry enabled, then closed issues #2298 and #2297. No pull requests, issues, reviews, or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: 22 次本人提交，另有 26 次自动提交，覆盖三个仓库
zh.summary: 当天记录了 **22 次本人提交**，另有 26 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 20 次本人提交新增了 MiMo 与混元 4 版评测产物，包括单时钟循环动画、静态 SVG 提示词页面，以及归档的鹈鹕骑车结果与提示词原文。该仓库还补充了 Console 对象模型、BSK daemon 启动与扩展连接排查、新开窗口原因及 BrowserSkill 快捷功能等知识笔记。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 2 次本人提交将画廊升级为 Pages 首页，支持双语、明暗主题和复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，并新增 12 张小红书风格封面与可浏览画廊页面。`antfu` 回复了 `vercel-labs/skills` 的两个收录 issue，说明启用遥测后通过安装即可被 `skills.sh` 自动索引，随后关闭了 #2298 和 #2297。当天没有 pull request、issue、评审或发布记录。
